Yogi Adityanath Reviews UP Development, Launches Disaster Management HQ

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath reviewed development projects in Lucknow, emphasizing efforts to achieve zero poverty through Antyodaya cards for eligible families. He also inaugurated a disaster management headquarters in the city. The initiatives aim to improve public welfare and preparedness.
